label: Embroidery

traits.medium: thread-embroidered-looking cloud landscape on woven fabric
traits.texture: visible woven ground and raised thread-like marks with coherent stitch directions
traits.composition: thread directions follow cloud volume and preserve the broad silhouette and blue sky
traits.lighting: soft raking light gives delicate shadows to thread-like ridges

review_checks: light and shadow cloud masses stay distinct
limitations: No machine embroidery file, thread specification or repeatable stitch geometry is generated.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.
